snippet: Akkurat Café is a contemporary neighborhood specialty coffee shop and brunch spot located on Besselstraße in Berlin. The sleek, minimalist interior pairs locally roasted coffee with a carefully curated menu featuring avocado toast, fresh pastries, and gourmet sandwiches. It provides a bright, welcoming atmosphere for remote work, catch-ups, or relaxed weekend brunching.
